rationale: Final check verifies IBM's official Cloud Pak for Integration page labels the platform AI-powered and describes AI across its integration lifecycle and AI functions in App Connect. Retained official IBM 16.2.0 documentation also documents AI assistance and an LLM-powered agent. But the record is only a virtual processor core entitlement without a release/date, so these product-family/version-specific features cannot be confidently applied to that represented version. Preserve the adjudicated weak/forced positive.
ai_type_rationale: The platform's APIs, events, messaging, files and application integration are independently meaningful; AI augments rather than constitutes that core.
version_scope: No version in source record. Official current product page and IBM 16.2.0 documentation establish product-family AI, not its availability in the unversioned VPC entitlement.
issues: Product release/feature composition of the virtual-processor-core record is unknown; binary remains weak/forced.

sources.excerpt: An AI-powered integration. IBM Cloud Pak for Integration is a container-native, self-managed platform that unifies APIs, events, messaging, files, and applications under a single control plane. With AI across the lifecycle ...
